references.text: Describes Jesus' ministry in Galilee, which includes teaching in the synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all kinds of diseases and afflictions among the people, demonstrating Jesus' compassion and power in Galilee.
Mentions Jesus' journey through the region around the Sea of Galilee, highlighting his movements in the area and his ongoing ministry there.
Jesus goes up on a mountain, which may reflect his tendency to seek secluded places for prayer or teaching, similar to Matt 15:29.
